$$\frac{9}{(a+b+c)/2} \leq \frac{2}{a} + \frac{2}{b} + \frac{2}{c}$$

$$\frac{18}{a+b+c} \leq \frac{2}{a} + \frac{2}{b} + \frac{2}{c}$$
